item.description: If we, two normal-style people, were to compete in the Winter Olympics, we would immediately die. item.description: In the winter here, it’s not unusual to see a car on the side of I-35. item.title: I Am Dyeing My Hair Brown
item.description: I have an announcement: I am dyeing my hair brown—deep, thick, chocolatey brown. I do this to signal I am entering a period of mental and emotional darkness.
